# Checkbox Group

> A set of Checkboxes with one label, one value, and one validity between them.

`<slab-checkbox-group>` · Form · built on `[role=group]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/checkbox-group/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/checkbox-group.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-checkbox-group label="Toppings" name="toppings">
  <slab-checkbox label="Cheese" value="cheese"></slab-checkbox>
  <slab-checkbox label="Onions" value="onions"></slab-checkbox>
</slab-checkbox-group>
```

Each item is a [Checkbox](checkbox.md).

The group dispatches no "input" or "change" of its own. Each Checkbox's bubble up through it, as a native checkbox's do through a `<fieldset>`, so listen on the group and read its `values`.

## Keyboard

| Key   | What it does                                     |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Tab   | Moves between the Checkboxes, each its own stop. |
| Space | Checks or unchecks the focused one.              |

## Elements

### `<slab-checkbox-group>`

Import `slab-elements/checkbox-group.js` to register it.

A group of Checkboxes with no visual styles, with one label and one validity for all of them.

Checkboxes are found by class rather than by tag name, so your subclass of Checkbox can be named anything. The group's `values` are the values of every Checkbox that is checked and enabled, in the order they were checked, and its `value` is the first of them, as a Listbox's are.

It dispatches no "input" or "change" of its own. A Checkbox's bubble up through it, as a native checkbox's do through a `<fieldset>`, so a listener on the group hears every one and reads the group's `values`.

Style it through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(error)`, and `:state(required)`. How the Checkboxes are arranged is layout, so it's left to the styles around them.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                                                                     |
| `disabled`         | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                                                     |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.                                                                                  |
| `name`             | `string`  | `''`    | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                                                                                              |
| `required`         | `boolean` | `false` | Makes it invalid while it has no value, as `required` does a native control.                                                                                                                      |
| `value`            | `string`  | `''`    | The value of the first checked and enabled Checkbox, in the order they were checked. Setting it checks the Checkbox with that value, and only that one. Not reflected, to match a native control. |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                               |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                  | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own. Empty while it's valid. |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`           | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                      |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                 | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                |
| `values`                        | `string[]`                | The value of every checked and enabled Checkbox, in the order they were checked. Setting it checks the Checkboxes with those values, and only those.             |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                   |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                               |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.   |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                     |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                    |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`. |

#### Events

| Name      | Type    | Description                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `invalid` | `Event` | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown. |

#### Slots

| Name          | Type                | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default)     | `Checkbox`          |                                                                                                             |
| `description` | `Element \| string` | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`      | Text about the group, and its validity message when it has one |
| `group`            | The Checkboxes                                                 |
| `label`            | The label                                                      |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid      |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
| `:state(required)` | While it's required, for styles such as an asterisk.                                                                      |
